ns2:course.label: Reading French Grads
ns2:course.description: Grammar, vocabulary, and general and special reading; designed for graduate students desiring help in preparing for the French reading requirements for the Ph.D. Credit may not be used toward a graduate degree. Prerequisite: FR 500, or FR 101 and FR 102, or equivalent.
